name: SDN Record Retention
description: Keeps a rolling window of records on the node (default 72 hours) and deletes what falls out of it. Each target names a standard and its lane (provider and/or sources); the node's storage.expire host op deletes the lane's records whose own indexed time (WXF VALID_TIME_MS, OMM/MPE EPOCH, ...) is older than now minus window_hours, paging the store's record index. Default target: WXF from provider noaa-ncep. Owner 2026-10-12: a rolling 3-day window on the weather node, configurable, never an archive.

externalInterfaces.description: storage.expire: delete one lane's records older than a cutoff, through the store's record index (sdn-server internal/storage/record_expiry.go).

inputPorts.description: Cron timer tick (flows/record-retention.flow.json); a direct invoke needs none.

wildcardJustification.detail: One bounded JSON summary of the pass: window, cutoff, records deleted and not held; not a data record.

methods.description: Deletes every configured target's records older than now minus window_hours (plugin config; compiled default 72 h over WXF from provider noaa-ncep), at most max_deletes a pass, through the node's storage.expire.
